did: Made the second conversation essay, a vertical Playoff Delta short, as the A/B test of the pipeline. The owner turned down two formats (an explainer, then claims with verdicts) and moved the story to a pick-em game. Before kickoff, the owner picks who the Niners should root for in each NFC game, and the numbers rule on every pick with a referee's call. The owner green-lit podcast v4 (football calls, the owner's own intro and outro, the af_heart voice), chose layout A, asked for Mochi to be gold with red only when angry, and approved six three-second moments on a new football-field stage, with Tin Bird as the official throwing the flag. The 1:59 vertical video, its template thumbnail, a description with provenance and chapters, and a titles file are in the owner's Drive podcast folder, under 'Playoff Delta, week 12: the pick-em (2026-11-27)'. Everything the episode used beyond main was session-side: the verdict solver over crates/playoff_delta's rules, the gold palette and stronger emotion tints (patched locally and restored), the field stage, props and moments, and the episode compositor over main's hostAt.

calls.title: The order of the pick-em's judges
options: The playoff lock first, then the one-seed lock, then the worse-record rule
The one-seed lock first, then the playoff lock, then the worse-record rule
calls.why: This week the one-seed lock didn't move for any game (six more wins either way), so the order changed no verdict. The playoff lock is where the Niners' real uncertainty is.
calls.undo: Say the one seed should decide first; future weeks' verdicts are recomputed in that order.

calls.title: Thursday's three games judged as of before kickoff
options: Judge all seven from the week-11 standings
Judge only the four games not yet played
calls.why: The owner's picks were blind to the engine's verdicts, and the episode is the before-kickoff edition; the description says so.
calls.undo: Ask for the before episode to drop games already kicked off.

calls.title: A deterministic rotation for the moments
options: Rotate within the right moments and within the wrong moments, in round order
Pick each moment by a seeded hash of the round
calls.why: The owner asked for a mix that isn't the same every time; a rotation guarantees no back-to-back repeat and is readable.
calls.undo: Ask for a different mix rule; it's one function in the episode's compositor.

left: The engine change: a before-kickoff verdict per pending game, a union of root-for-a-team or either, with the judge that decided it (filed as some-ui#3589).

The rig changes the owner approved: the gold team palette with a red stripe, stronger angry and celebration tints, a 49ers jersey costume, the football and laptop props, the field stage and the six moments (filed under #3521). This episode drew them session-side.
A cards-renderer path for a vertical two-character episode; this one was composited in the session over main's hostAt with two beat lists.
The week-12 after episode, once the games are played: the engine already scores played results.
The owner may want to remove the service account's writer access on the uploaded video.
